headline: Purbaya Affirms Q2-2026 Economy Won't Fall Far From 5.4 Percent, Here Are the Factors
summary: Purbaya projects Indonesia's national economic growth in Q2-2026 will fall within 5.4-5.6 percent, citing heavy pressure from external global factors. The projection is a government forecast.
why: Indonesia is Southeast Asia's largest economy, and its quarterly growth rate shapes rupiah sentiment, bond yields and regional capital flows.
